intro: Weapons of Elunite is the culmination of an early rite of passage for night elf warriors in Darnassus. After recovering raw ore blessed by Elune, the warrior brings the material to the skilled smith Mathiel to be forged into arms fit for a defender of Kalimdor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Friend, I have crafted these weapons with the elunite you brought to me. Please, take whichever most suits you.
And I must thank you. Working with elunite is both an honor and a pleasure.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
